purpose: Complete GRF-01 elimination step D at theorem-schema level: an exact odd-prime finite-ring obstruction for affine integer systems, without importing any concrete CUT population or granting pruning credit.

mathematical_kernel.domain: M in Z^(r x n), c,b in Z^r, z in Z^n, q=p^e with p an odd prime and e>=1
mathematical_kernel.exact_image: I_q(M,c) = {c + M*z mod q : z in (Z/qZ)^n}
mathematical_kernel.lattice_equivalence: The system is solvable iff b-c belongs to M*Z^n + q*Z^r, equivalently iff b-c is in the integer column lattice of [M | q*I_r].
mathematical_kernel.empty_rule: If b mod q is not in I_q(M,c), then no integral lift z in Z^n can satisfy the source-locked affine equations; classify ODD_PRIME_COLUMN_IMAGE_EMPTY.
accepted_exact_methods: exact HNF/SNF integer-lattice membership for [M | q*I_r]
exact finite-ring enumeration when the quotient is explicitly bounded and small
an equivalent exact source-locked column-image certificate
mathematical_kernel.sat_semantics: Membership in the local image is only a passed necessary local condition. It does not prove an integral/global solution.
mathematical_kernel.prime_power_semantics: q may be an odd prime power. Reducing only modulo p is weaker than testing modulo p^e and must not be silently promoted.

ownership.concrete_application_owner: stage32-01-178-mainbatch or stage32cut-mainbatch only after an explicit current semantic adapter
